title: kramastotra — kram-p11-v11
question: Hence the Lord's power — enjoying varied, unvaried, beyond-difference stations — ever goes, never into division, nohow. So on this unagitated ground — Your step it is — may my heart-ground grow one-pointed, Bhairava Lord.
